1. Pick the region and open the link. It opens the CloudFormation **Quick create stack** page with the recipe template and settings filled in. Sign in to your AWS account if asked.
2. Leave **HuggingFaceToken** empty: the model is not gated.
3. Leave **ExecutionRoleArn** empty to create a role that can only pull the container image and write logs, or set the ARN of an existing SageMaker execution role.
4. Select **I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources** and choose **Create stack**.

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-2xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-2xlarge-vllm-tp1-20aa958161.json).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-2xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-2xlarge-vllm-tp1-20aa958161.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-2xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.26.0-transformers5.10.2-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION": "0.95",
    "SM_VLLM_KV_CACHE_DTYPE": "fp8",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "65536",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "8",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "1",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.2xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-2xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.26.0-transformers5.10.2-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_CHUNKED_PREFILL": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_PREFIX_CACHING": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION": "0.95",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "65536",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "8",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "1",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.2xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

1. Pick the region and open the link. It opens the CloudFormation **Quick create stack** page with the recipe template and settings filled in. Sign in to your AWS account if asked.
2. Leave **HuggingFaceToken** empty: the model is not gated.
3. Leave **ExecutionRoleArn** empty to create a role that can only pull the container image and write logs, or set the ARN of an existing SageMaker execution role.
4. Select **I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources** and choose **Create stack**.

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-12xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-12xlarge-vllm-tp1-dp2-0b3869e4fc.json).

<hfoption id="AWS CLI">

The commands create a CloudFormation stack from the recipe template, wait until the endpoint is `InService`, and delete the stack when you are done. They need the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/getting-started-install.html).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-12xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-12xlarge-vllm-tp1-dp2-0b3869e4fc.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-12xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.26.0-transformers5.10.2-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_DATA_PARALLEL_SIZE": "2",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "65536",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "16",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "1",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.12xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

</hfoption>
</hfoptions>

| `SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN` | `--max-model-len` | `65536` |
| `SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS` | `--max-num-batched-tokens` | `4096` |
| `SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS` | `--max-num-seqs` | `16` |
| `SM_VLLM_MODEL` | `--model` | `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16` |
| `SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND` | `--moe-backend` | `flashinfer_cutlass` |
| `SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER` | `--reasoning-parser` | `nemotron_v3` |
| `SM_VLLM_REVISION` | `--revision` | `d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d` |
| `SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME` | `--served-model-name` | `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16` |
| `SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE` | `--tensor-parallel-size` | `1` |
| `SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER` | `--tool-call-parser` | `qwen3_coder` |

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-12xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-12xlarge-vllm-tp2-bd698d3c61.json).

<hfoption id="AWS CLI">

The commands create a CloudFormation stack from the recipe template, wait until the endpoint is `InService`, and delete the stack when you are done. They need the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/getting-started-install.html).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-12xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-12xlarge-vllm-tp2-bd698d3c61.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-12xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.26.0-transformers5.10.2-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "65536",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "16",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "2",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.12xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

</hfoption>
</hfoptions>

import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-12xlarge"

role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_CHUNKED_PREFILL": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_PREFIX_CACHING": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "65536",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "16",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "2",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}

    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.12xlarge",

<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-24xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.26.0-transformers5.10.2-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_DATA_PARALLEL_SIZE": "2",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "65536",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "16",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "2",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.24xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

1. Pick the region and open the link. It opens the CloudFormation **Quick create stack** page with the recipe template and settings filled in. Sign in to your AWS account if asked.
2. Leave **HuggingFaceToken** empty: the model is not gated.
3. Leave **ExecutionRoleArn** empty to create a role that can only pull the container image and write logs, or set the ARN of an existing SageMaker execution role.
4. Select **I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources** and choose **Create stack**.

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-24xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-24xlarge-vllm-tp4-5983f16aa9.json).

<hfoption id="AWS CLI">

The commands create a CloudFormation stack from the recipe template, wait until the endpoint is `InService`, and delete the stack when you are done. They need the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/getting-started-install.html).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-24xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-24xlarge-vllm-tp4-5983f16aa9.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="Python">

The snippet calls the SageMaker APIs directly with boto3. Outside SageMaker Studio, replace `get_execution_role()` with the role lookup from [Set up the SDK](../tutorials/sagemaker-sdk/setup-sagemaker-sdk#execution-role).

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-24xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.26.0-transformers5.10.2-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_CHUNKED_PREFILL": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_PREFIX_CACHING": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_KV_CACHE_DTYPE": "fp8",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "131072",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "16",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "4",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.24xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

```python
sm.delete_endpoint(EndpointName=name)
sm.delete_endpoint_config(EndpointConfigName=name)
sm.delete_model(ModelName=name)
```

</hfoption>
</hfoptions>

```python
import os

import boto3
from sagemaker.core.helper.session_helper import Session, get_execution_role

# AWS region where the endpoint runs
region = "us-east-1"
name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-24xlarge"

sess = Session(boto_session=boto3.Session(region_name=region))
role = get_execution_role()
sm = sess.boto_session.client("sagemaker")

image = f"763104351884.dkr.ecr.{region}.amazonaws.com/huggingface-vllm:0.26.0-transformers5.10.2-gpu-py312-cu130-ubuntu22.04"
environment = {
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_AUTO_TOOL_CHOICE": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_ENABLE_EXPERT_PARALLEL": "true",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_BACKEND": "flashinfer",
    "SM_VLLM_MAMBA_CACHE_MODE": "align",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN": "65536",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS": "4096",
    "SM_VLLM_MAX_NUM_SEQS": "16",
    "SM_VLLM_MODEL": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_MOE_BACKEND": "flashinfer_cutlass",
    "SM_VLLM_REASONING_PARSER": "nemotron_v3",
    "SM_VLLM_REVISION": "d468880b6ad3c6e0d21377ce7242adaea4cc884d",
    "SM_VLLM_SERVED_MODEL_NAME": "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    "SM_VLLM_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE": "4",
    "SM_VLLM_TOOL_CALL_PARSER": "qwen3_coder"
}
# gated models need a Hugging Face token: read it from your environment
if "HF_TOKEN" in os.environ:
    environment["HF_TOKEN"] = os.environ["HF_TOKEN"]

sm.create_model(
    ModelName=name,
    ExecutionRoleArn=role,
    PrimaryContainer={"Image": image, "Environment": environment},
)
sm.create_endpoint_config(
    EndpointConfigName=name,
    ProductionVariants=[
        {
            "VariantName": "AllTraffic",
            "ModelName": name,
            "InstanceType": "ml.g7e.24xlarge",
            "InitialInstanceCount": 1,
            "InferenceAmiVersion": "al2023-ami-sagemaker-inference-gpu-4-1",
            "ContainerStartupHealthCheckTimeoutInSeconds": 3600,
        }
    ],
)
sm.create_endpoint(EndpointName=name, EndpointConfigName=name)

# wait up to 90 minutes for the endpoint to reach InService
sm.get_waiter("endpoint_in_service").wait(
    EndpointName=name, WaiterConfig={"Delay": 60, "MaxAttempts": 90}
)
```

Delete the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, and the model to stop billing:

1. Pick the region and open the link. It opens the CloudFormation **Quick create stack** page with the recipe template and settings filled in. Sign in to your AWS account if asked.
2. Leave **HuggingFaceToken** empty: the model is not gated.
3. Leave **ExecutionRoleArn** empty to create a role that can only pull the container image and write logs, or set the ARN of an existing SageMaker execution role.
4. Select **I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources** and choose **Create stack**.

The stack reaches `CREATE_COMPLETE` when the endpoint `nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-24xlarge` is `InService`, usually after 10 to 30 minutes. To stop billing, delete the stack: it deletes the endpoint, the endpoint configuration, the model, and the role. [View the template](https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-24xlarge-vllm-tp4-cb3a1374c5.json).

</hfoption>
<hfoption id="AWS CLI">

The commands create a CloudFormation stack from the recipe template, wait until the endpoint is `InService`, and delete the stack when you are done. They need the [AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/getting-started-install.html).

```bash
# AWS region where the endpoint runs
REGION=us-east-1
NAME=nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-24xlarge

aws cloudformation create-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME" \
  --template-url https://hf-sagemaker-recipes.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/templates/nvidia-nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16/g7e-24xlarge-vllm-tp4-cb3a1374c5.json \
  --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM \
  --parameters ParameterKey=EndpointName,ParameterValue="$NAME"

# returns when the endpoint is InService; run it again if it times out after one hour
aws cloudformation wait stack-create-complete --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

Delete the stack to stop billing:

```bash
aws cloudformation delete-stack --region "$REGION" --stack-name "$NAME"
```

## Send requests

The endpoint serves the OpenAI chat completions API. SageMaker exposes it at an OpenAI-compatible route that accepts a short-lived bearer token signed with your AWS credentials, so any OpenAI client works, including streaming:

```python
from openai import OpenAI
from sagemaker.core.token_generator import generate_token

# AWS region and name of the endpoint
region = "us-east-1"
endpoint_name = "nvidia-nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b-a3b-bf16-g7e-2xlarge"

client = OpenAI(
    base_url=f"https://runtime.sagemaker.{region}.amazonaws.com/endpoints/{endpoint_name}/openai/v1",
    # the token is valid for up to 12 hours
    api_key=generate_token(region=region),
)

stream = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "What is the capital of France?"}],
    max_tokens=512,
    stream=True,
)
for chunk in stream:
    if chunk.choices and chunk.choices[0].delta.content:
        print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content, end="")
```

To call the endpoint with `invoke_endpoint` instead, see [Invoke the endpoint](./deploy-a-recipe#invoke-the-endpoint).
